message.content: {"facts": ["Young Czechs have more positive perceptions and attitudes towards people from different ethnic backgrounds compared to older generations.", "There are specific initiatives and programs in the Czech Republic aimed at promoting diversity and inclusion among the younger generation.", "The Czech Diversity Charter, Multikulturní centrum Praha, Nesehnuti, and International School of Prague are examples of such initiatives.", "These initiatives have had a positive impact on the Czech Republic in promoting diversity and inclusion."]}
